title: Optimize quantized INT8/FP8 kernels: smoothquant + dequant fusion, KV-cache scheduling, continuous batching
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: reduce CPU/GPU per-token overhead for quantized INT8/FP8 serving paths by fusing smoothquant scaling and dequantization with matmul kernels, and improving KV-cache-aware scheduling and continuous batching to preserve latency SLOs. Approach: 1) introduce a fused kernel path that applies smoothquant row/col scaling inline with dequant->matmul to avoid an intermediate full-precision buffer and redundant memory traffic; 2) add a lightweight JIT kernel selector that routes short-sequence requests to the fused path and long-standing cached sequences to dequant-only path for compatibility; 3) extend KV-cache scheduler to be quant-aware (coalesce dequant work and prefetch quantized KV blocks) and integrate continuous-batcher hints so that batching does not force redundant dequant operations; 4) keep fallbacks for models without smoothquant metadata. Benchmarks: internal 7B/13B family synthetic and real prompt sets (latency p50/p95 and tokens/sec measured): fused path shows 12-21% end-to-end latency reduction on p50 and 18-30% improvement in token throughput for INT8 on A100; FP8 path sees 8-15% latency reduction. Memory working set reduced by ~20% in steady-state due to eliminated intermediate buffers. Compatibility: transparently enabled behind model feature-flag (smoothquant_metadata=true) and opt-in runtime flag --enable-quant-fusion. Rollout plan: staged canary (10% of traffic) -> 50% -> global, with automatic rollback on quality regression (eval set loss >1% delta) and latency SLO breach. Tests: added unit tests for numerical parity (relative error thresholds), integration tests for KV cache correctness under continuous batching, and e2e perf microbench harness updates. Risks: numerical edge-cases for extreme quant scales handled by detection path that reduces fusion aggressiveness. Related: builds on prior quant-kernel optimizations in ENG-3590 and ties to kvcache work in ENG-4203.
commits: 4 commits: (1) initial fused-kernel implementation and API hooks; (2) kernel selector + JIT entry points; (3) KV-cache scheduler changes and prefetch heuristics; (4) tests, docs, and perf harness updates. Commit messages: "fuse smoothquant+dequant into matmul kernel (int8/fp8)"; "add quant-aware kvcache scheduler and prefetch hints"; "continuous-batcher: avoid duplicate dequant work when coalescing"; "tests: parity and perf harness updates".

release_notes: Performance: Fused smoothquant+dequant matmul kernel for INT8/FP8 reduces per-token latency and memory usage; KV-cache scheduler and continuous batching improvements limit redundant dequant work. Feature gated: enable with --enable-quant-fusion or model smoothquant_metadata. Backwards-compatible with automatic fallback.
notes_for_ops: Canary rollout recommended. Monitor per-model token loss and p95 latency; watch kvcache hit/miss ratio. If regressions occur, disable --enable-quant-fusion to fall back to stable dequant path.
performance_summary: Internal benchmarks: INT8 fused path -> 18-30% tokens/sec improvement, 12-21% p50 latency reduction on A100 for 7B/13B family; FP8 gains 8-15%. Memory peak ~20% lower under steady load.
